_comment: Tracked provenance pin for the Fresh38 capture harness (AIOS-RUNTIME-RELIABILITY-01 / FIX-MEAS01).
Before this file, run_fresh38_case_batch.ps1 preferred an opaque session-scratch copy of the
fell back to the .artifacts harness. Both happened to be byte-identical, but nothing checked that,
so a canonical qualification run depended on a file no one could verify or reproduce.
The .artifacts harness directory is now the single canonical source. It is deliberately gitignored
(/.artifacts/ in .gitignore) as a build/eval artifact area, so the bytes themselves are not tracked;
this file makes their identity tracked and mechanically verified at every capture instead. A hash
mismatch fails the capture rather than producing a silently different SUT.
To intentionally change the harness: update the hash here in the same commit as the harness change,
and state why. Never edit this file to make a failing capture pass.

verified_identical_to.note: deprecated scratch copy; no longer preferred by the wrapper, retained only as historical evidence
